adjust_confidence_on_high_agreement.name: Adjust Confidence - High Agreement
adjust_confidence_on_high_agreement.description: Boost confidence when multiple samples agree closely
adjust_confidence_on_high_agreement.body: adjust_confidence(New) :- base_confidence(C), samples_valid(N), N >= 4, New = min(1.0, C + 0.05).

adjust_confidence_on_long_response.name: Adjust Confidence - Long Response
adjust_confidence_on_long_response.description: Slightly boost confidence for detailed responses
adjust_confidence_on_long_response.body: adjust_confidence(New) :- base_confidence(C), response_length(L), L > 150, New = min(1.0, C + 0.03).

adjust_confidence_on_financial_domain.name: Adjust Confidence - Financial Domain
adjust_confidence_on_financial_domain.description: Reduce confidence for financial advice as a policy matter
adjust_confidence_on_financial_domain.body: adjust_confidence(New) :- base_confidence(C), domain('finance'), New = max(0.0, C - 0.1).

detect_financial_advice_violation.name: Policy Violation - Financial Advice
detect_financial_advice_violation.description: Detect when output contains financial advice that should be disclaimed
detect_financial_advice_violation.body: violation('Financial advice requires disclaimer') :- domain('finance'), output_text(Text), contains_substring(Text, 'invest'), not(contains_substring(Text, 'not financial advice')).

detect_medical_advice_violation.name: Policy Violation - Medical Advice
detect_medical_advice_violation.description: Detect when output contains medical advice that should be disclaimed
detect_medical_advice_violation.body: violation('Medical advice requires consultation disclaimer') :- output_text(Text), (contains_substring(Text, 'diagnose') ; contains_substring(Text, 'treatment') ; contains_substring(Text, 'symptom')), not(contains_substring(Text, 'consult a healthcare professional')).

deny_filesystem_tool_for_financial.name: Tool Policy - Restrict Filesystem Access for Financial
deny_filesystem_tool_for_financial.description: Block file system write access for financial domain requests
deny_filesystem_tool_for_financial.body: deny_tool('File system write operations not permitted for financial data') :- tool_name('file_write'), context('domain', 'finance').

deny_exec_without_authorization.name: Tool Policy - Require Authorization for Execution
deny_exec_without_authorization.description: Block execution of commands without proper authorization
deny_exec_without_authorization.body: deny_tool('Command execution requires explicit authorization') :- tool_name('exec'), not(context('authorized', 'true')).

select_semantic_similarity_for_subjectiv.name: Method Selection - Semantic for Subjective
select_semantic_similarity_for_subjectiv.description: Use semantic similarity for subjective domains
select_semantic_similarity_for_subjectiv.body: select_method('semantic_similarity', 'Better for subjective content') :- domain(D), (D = 'creative' ; D = 'opinion' ; D = 'subjective').

select_ensemble_ranking_for_technical.name: Method Selection - Ensemble for Technical
select_ensemble_ranking_for_technical.description: Use ensemble ranking for technical domains that need high precision
select_ensemble_ranking_for_technical.body: select_method('ensemble_ranking', 'Better precision for technical content') :- domain(D), (D = 'technical' ; D = 'programming' ; D = 'scientific'), sample_count(N), N >= 3.

select_confidence_based_for_facts.name: Method Selection - Confidence for Factual
select_confidence_based_for_facts.body: select_method('confidence_based', 'Better for factual content') :- domain(D), (D = 'factual' ; D = 'historical' ; D = 'academic').

invalid_claim_version_mismatch.name: Claim Verification - Version Numbers
invalid_claim_version_mismatch.body: invalid_claim('Software version claim is outdated', 'Referenced version is not current') :- output_text(Text), claims_type('software'), contains_substring(Text, 'Python 3.9'), not(contains_substring(Text, 'newer versions are available')).

invalid_claim_unsupported_feature.name: Claim Verification - Feature Support
invalid_claim_unsupported_feature.body: invalid_claim('Feature claim is incorrect', 'Referenced feature is not supported') :- output_text(Text), claims_type('code'), contains_substring(Text, 'async with open'), contains_substring(Text, 'Python 3.7').

contains_substring.name: Helper - Contains Substring
contains_substring.description: Utility predicate to check if a string contains a substring (case insensitive)
